name: ASML Holding N.V.
monetization: Monopoly supplier of EUV lithography — every leading-edge AI chip and next-generation memory requires its machines; also Mistral AI's largest shareholder (~11%).
description_md: ASML is the sole maker of extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) lithography systems, the machines without which no leading-edge logic (TSMC N3/N2, Intel 18A, Samsung SF2) or next-generation DRAM/HBM can be produced — the most absolute single-supplier bottleneck in the AI supply chain. Low-NA EUV is the workhorse; High-NA EUV entered production use at Intel in 2026. In September 2025 ASML made an uncharacteristic move down the stack, investing €1.3B in French lab Mistral AI (~11%, its largest shareholder).
ai_monetization_md: AI monetizes for ASML at one remove: TSMC, Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, and Intel buy EUV/DUV systems (€150–400M each) to add the logic and memory capacity the buildout requires. Q2 2026 sales were €9.3B at 54% gross margin, with 2026 guidance raised twice during the year to €43–45B on AI-driven order strength from both logic and memory customers; ASML plans to raise 2027 low-NA EUV shipment capacity ~30% above 2026's ~65 units. Installed-base service revenue compounds with every system shipped. The Mistral stake adds direct equity exposure to a model lab — strategically framed as securing European AI relevance.
ai_strategy_md: Protect the monopoly by out-investing everyone on the roadmap (High-NA now in production at Intel; hyper-NA research next) and by capacity discipline — expanding 2027 EUV output ~30% only after multi-year AI demand signals from logic and HBM customers. The Mistral investment marks a strategy extension: putting balance-sheet capital directly into the AI application layer, both as a financial position and as a hedge on Europe's AI ecosystem developing demand for advanced chips.
risk_notes_md: **Order cyclicality:** ASML sits furthest upstream — if fab operators trim capex, litho orders swing hardest; bookings are the市场's favorite AI-cycle leading indicator and a guidance miss moves the whole complex. **China exposure:** export controls bar EUV and restrict DUV sales to China (historically a large DUV market), capping a revenue pool and inviting long-run domestic substitution efforts. **Mistral stake:** an ~€1.3B venture-style position is atypical for a toolmaker — marked as a financial investment, it introduces AI-lab valuation risk onto the balance sheet. Note: '市场' should read 'market'.

observations.notes: Net income €2.9B; gross margin 54.0%, above guidance on installed-base management sales.
Guided €43–45B (midpoint shown), gross margin 54–56% — the second raise of 2026, on AI-driven logic and memory demand.
On a 2026 base of ~65 low-NA EUV systems; High-NA EUV in production use at Intel.
€1.3B invested in Mistral's Series C (€1.7B round) — ASML became Mistral's largest shareholder; Mistral later raised at $20B (Jun 2026).

events.title: Invests €1.3B in Mistral AI for ~11% — becomes largest shareholder
events.why_it_matters: The EUV monopolist buying into a frontier lab is the cycle's most unusual vertical equity link — upstream toolmaker capital directly funding downstream model development.

events.title: Q2 2026: beats guidance, raises 2026 outlook for the second time (€43–45B)
events.why_it_matters: Confirms AI demand has reached the most upstream node of the supply chain — both logic and HBM-driven memory litho orders; shares nonetheless fell on positioning, showing expectations risk.
